serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: Alright. I’m listening. #Landlord.Face.Grin Landlord: I knew you would understand. Money connects people on a level that friendship and other stupid things will never be able ro reach! #Landlord.Face.Normal Landlord: So. Did you perhaps hear about an island called Paradisium? You: Yes! I’m also interested in it! Landlord: I knew it! Great minds do think the same! Or should I say, great wallets! Hahahahahaha! Landlord: As you probably already know, getting on the island is no easy task, but it is well worth it. It’s full of people like us. People that are no longer concerned about these filthy masses. Landlord: You see, I was trying to get there for the longest time, but the amount of fake rumors and scams was just too much for me to get around. Landlord: I was ready to give up, but recently, something changed. I finally found a way to get in! Landlord: One of the clerks of the island is willing to get me in. Landlord: You see, there’s a submission system in place. You can apply to get in there and if they deem you worthy, they grant you citizenship. Landlord: There’s only one problem…{{wi}} The whole system is totally broken. Landlord: Applicants wait years only for their admissions to be rejected with no clear reason. If that’s how it is, why even have such a system in the first place, right? You: Right! It doesn’t make any sense. Landlord: That’s precisely what a simple-minded fool would think! You: … Landlord: The system exists solely for one reason! For the island officials to get bribes! Landlord: Truly ingenious system! You: Can’t they just make the citizenship cost money? Wouldn’t that be easier? Landlord: You still don’t get it. Transparency! If you could just buy citizenship there would have to be a fixed price, but if there’s a gray area… {{wi}}you can overcharge unlucky losers as much as you want! And no one will bat an eye! Landlord: Of course, if it’s me, I will get us the best price possible! I know a thing or two about negotiations! You: That’s nice and all, but I don’t understand something. What do you need us for? Can’t you just get on the island by yourself? Landlord: Yes, that was the plan, but…{{wi}} there have been unforeseen circumstances. Landlord: Turns out the island has a problem with having too many old men. It has become such an issue that many young people, especially women, have started to leave the island. Landlord: If I don’t bring at least two young, attractive people with me, even a bribe won’t help. Damn, I guess even a dream island has its own set of issues. You: You need two young people, but why us specifically? Landlord: What? Do you know any other set of millionaires below the age of 30? Please, do tell me about them! You: Alright, alright! Sorry. Landlord: So, how about it? You will fill my quota and I will deal with the clerk. Do we have a deal? You: Sure, I guess. How much do you need for the bribes. Landlord: Hmmm, around 3 million… You: That’s a lot, but ok, I guess. #Landlord.Face.Grin Landlord: …each. You: Each? {{wi}}Each?! That’s 6 million in total! #Landlord.Face.Surprised Landlord: S-Stop screaming, you fool! Do you want the entire complex to know that we are rich?! #Landlord.Face.Unhappy You: S-Sorry. 6 million just for the bribes? I would need at least another 5 for comfortable living there. That’s 11 million in total. Without this money there’s no point even thinking about going there. Landlord: Listen, get the money and then we will talk about the details. Ok? You: Ok. Landlord: As soon as I get the money I will start preparing for the departure, so get ready! You: Sure.
